dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal region displays multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures defined by thin, high-intensity light-colored perimeters that contrast sharply against the darker base pixel values, exhibiting a sharp gradient transition at the outer edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of small, solid, asymmetrical high-intensity light pixel clusters primarily localized in the anterior-dorsal transition zone and interspersed between the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a wide-angled obtuse triangle at the highest point of the dorsal curve, while smaller structures form an irregular linear sequence extending toward the posterior flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior flipper region exhibits parallel, low-contrast linear indentations or ridges that diverge from the base of the tail toward the distal edge.
